body.statement:
Conditional on effective compatibility density, the effective moving-remainder assumption, and effective moving-offset encoding, suppose \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), and \(\delta_n(C)=\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) on every rational compact polytope \(C\). Compute \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\), certify a Gaussian rule for \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\), and transfer it by Carter's positive-cell kernel. On each fixed compact \(C\), put \(\chi_n(C)=d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\). Its semantic coverage deficit and normalized separated-risk excess are bounded by
\[
 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
 +\mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}
 +H_C\chi_n(C)+\mathbf1\{\chi_n(C)>\tau_n\}
 +\rho_{\mathrm{led},n}+\operatorname{Tail}_n(C)+\operatorname{Round}_n.
\]
The effective remainder, offset, Gaussian-integration, and certificate ledgers choose \(\tau_n,\xi_n\downarrow0\) and vanishing certificate accuracy so that this bound tends to zero. The construction uses \(\widehat c_n\), not the unknown limit \(c\), and makes no global-honesty claim on the unbounded regions \(D_{n,v}\).
body.justification: The theorem now gives a determinate compact moving-offset rule using computable rational approximations to the observed offset.
body.gap: It does not extend compact control to all unbounded finite-sample truth regions.
body.consumer: Drifting capacity and endpoint-program faces receive an explicit boundary and offset charge.
body.proof_tex:
\textbf{Technique: exact affine-slack coupling, finite-arrangement stability,
and parameter-independent Le Cam transfer.}
Fix a rational compact polytope \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\).  Let
\(L_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\),
and let \(A_\Psi\) have rows \(\alpha_j'\) for
\(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\), as in
\(\text{def:moving-slack-system}\).  Since every active cut satisfies
\(\psi_j(p_0)=0\),
\[
 c_n
 =A_\Psi\sqrt n\{p_n(0)-p_0\}.                                \tag{18}
\]
The local-family affine-hull assumption puts the vector after \(A_\Psi\)
in \(L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\); hence (18) and the definition of
\(\mathcal K_0\) give
\[
 c_n\in\mathcal K_0\qquad\text{for every }n.                  \tag{19}
\]
This proves compatibility of the observed moving offset rather than assuming
it.

Choose a positive rational \(\xi_n\downarrow0\).  The effective moving-offset
encoding assumption returns
\(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\)
with
\[
 \|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n.                         \tag{20}
\]
For every active facet, the exact identity in
\(\text{def:moving-slack-system}\) gives
\[
 \zeta_{n,j}(u)-(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u)
 =(c_{n,j}-\widehat c_{n,j})+e_{n,j}(u).                        \tag{21}
\]
Therefore, with
\(\delta_n(C)=\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\),
\[
 \max_j\sup_{u\in C}
 |\zeta_{n,j}(u)-(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u)|
 \le\delta_n(C)+\xi_n.                                        \tag{22}
\]
Because \(c_n\to c\) and (20) holds, all \(c_n\) and
\(\widehat c_n\), apart from finitely many, lie in one compact subset of
\(\mathcal K_0\).  Apply
\(\text{lem:finite-completed-arrangement-stability}\) on that compact offset
set.  It follows from (22), simultaneously for every completed semantic
union, that actual and \(\widehat c_n\)-offset label means on \(C\) can be
matched at Mahalanobis displacement at most
\[
 H_C\{\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\},                                     \tag{23}
\]
and that the corresponding distances to every rival semantic union change by
at most twice (23).  Equality faces cause no loss of a label because the
completed construction assigns every equality to all incident cells.  The
score-centering discrepancy is bounded by the centered expansion modulus
\(d_n(C)\).  Thus, after increasing the computable active-set constant if
necessary to absorb the factor two, every label and separated-risk matching
displacement is bounded by
\[
 H_C\chi_n(C),\qquad
 \chi_n(C)=d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)+\xi_n.                            \tag{24}
\]

We next charge possible sign changes without imposing a margin assumption.
For \(W_0\sim N_d(h,\Sigma_0)\),
\(c_j+a_j'W_0\) has variance
\(a_j'\Sigma_0a_j>0\): positivity follows from
\(a_j\ne0\) and \(\Sigma_0\succ0\).  Its density is bounded by
\(\{2\pi a_j'\Sigma_0a_j\}^{-1/2}\), uniformly in \(c_j+a_j'h\).
Consequently, for every \(s\ge0\),
\[
 \Pr_h\{|c_j+a_j'W_0|\le s\}
 \le\min\left\{1,
 \frac{2s}{\sqrt{2\pi}\{a_j'\Sigma_0a_j\}^{1/2}}\right\}.     \tag{25}
\]
The union bound over the finite active list turns (25) exactly into
\(\mathfrak b_0(s)\).  If the actual and reference signs differ, (21)--(24)
show that either \(\chi_n(C)>\tau_n\), or the reference slack lies in the
band of width \(\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\).  Thus all moving-boundary failures have
probability at most
\[
 \mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}
 +\mathbf 1\{\chi_n(C)>\tau_n\}.                               \tag{26}
\]

By \(\text{prop:carter-fixed-m-positive-cell}\), the positive-cell Carter
kernels apply on \(C\) for all sufficiently large \(n\), with error
\[
 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}
 =C_{2/\kappa}\frac{|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|}{\sqrt n}.    \tag{27}
\]
The kernel is independent of \(u\).  Replace its matched score-normal
covariance by \(\Sigma_0\); the Gaussian Hellinger calculation recorded in
\(\text{lem:compact-moving-remainder-covariance}\) contributes
\(\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\to0\).  Applying
\(\text{lem:bounded-semantic-transfer-by-tv}\) first to each indicator
\(\mathbf1\{v\in A\}\), and then to the normalized loss
\(\ell_0(A)\in[0,1]\), gives the separate coverage and risk charges
\[
 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}+
 \operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C).                              \tag{28}
\]
Gaussian translation between the matched means in (24) contributes at most
the displayed finite-arrangement term \(H_C\chi_n(C)\); this follows directly
by integrating the likelihood-ratio halfspace for two equal-covariance
Gaussians and using
\(2\Phi(x/2)-1\le x/\sqrt{2\pi}\), with the harmless numerical factor
absorbed in the enumerated \(H_C\).

We also verify that the rational offset object to which the Gaussian
certificate is applied is a legal encoded experiment.  Because
\(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\), rational linear algebra gives a rational
\(z_n\in L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) with
\(A_\Psi z_n=\widehat c_n\).  For every fixed \(u\), relative interiority and
the tangent-image condition put
\(p_0+t(z_n+Bu)\) in \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) for all sufficiently small
positive \(t\).  Its feasible optimal branch completion has active signs
\[
 \operatorname{sgn}\{\alpha_j'(z_n+Bu)\}
 =\operatorname{sgn}(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u),                  \tag{28a}
\]
with zero assigned to every incident completion.  Hence the offset semantic
cells cover \(\mathbb R^d\).  To check the separated domain, take a strict
chamber direction of the homogeneous completed fan.  Along a sufficiently
long multiple of this direction, the fixed offsets in (28a) are dominated by
the strict homogeneous slacks.  Distances from the resulting mean to every
rival closed polyhedral component therefore grow linearly: for each rival,
one rational row has gap \(t\gamma+O(1)\) with \(\gamma>0\), and
for every point \(g\) of that rival component the row inequality gives
\[
 t\gamma+O(1)\le a'(ty-g)
 \le\|a\|_{\Sigma_0}\|ty-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}.                 \tag{28b}
\]
The row is nonzero, so its \(\Sigma_0\)-norm is positive.  Taking the infimum
over \(g\) in (28b), the finitely many lower bounds eventually exceed the
fixed \(r_0\).  If there are no active cuts, there is one global semantic
label and
the separated-domain condition is immediate.  Thus the offset object has a
complete label cover, covariance \(\Sigma_0\succ0\), and a nonempty separated
domain.  Its data are rational, so
\(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\in\mathfrak E\).

Under the affirmative effective-compatible-density premise, the conditional
theorem \(\text{thm:certglue-termination}\) supplies the requested replayable
finite Gaussian rule for the rational offset experiment
\(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\), together with its outward gluing ledger.
Applying the forward Carter kernel and the score map to that rule produces
\(K_n\).  The triangle inequality, (26), and (28), followed by the chart,
tail, and rounding inequalities certified in
\(\text{def:multinomial-transfer-handle}\), gives for both semantic coverage
deficit and normalized separated-risk excess the claimed bound
\[
 \begin{split}
 &\varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
 +\mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}
 +H_C\chi_n(C)+\mathbf1\{\chi_n(C)>\tau_n\}\\
 &\hspace{35mm}
 +\rho_{\mathrm{led},n}+\operatorname{Tail}_n(C)
 +\operatorname{Round}_n.                                     
 \end{split}                                                    \tag{29}
\]
Each term is nonnegative and is added with its certified outward sign.

For completeness, we give a schedule rather than merely asserting one.
The local expansion and
\(\text{lem:compact-moving-remainder-covariance}\) imply
\(d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)\to0\).  Use the effective enclosures of the supplied
local family, moving remainder, and rational offset to obtain rational
\(\overline\chi_n(C)\ge\chi_n(C)\) with
\(\overline\chi_n(C)\to0\), and set
\[
 \tau_n=\sqrt{\overline\chi_n(C)+n^{-2}},
 \qquad \xi_n\le n^{-1}.                                      \tag{30}
\]
An outward rational enclosure of the square root is used in the executable
record.  Then \(\tau_n\downarrow0\) after replacing it by its running
minimum, and
\(\chi_n(C)/\tau_n\to0\), so the indicator in (29) is eventually zero.
Choose Gaussian truncation, quadrature, certificate accuracy, and simplex
rounding so that each of the last three terms in (29) is at most \(n^{-1}\).
The effective premises make each such finite search terminate.  Equations
(25) and (30) imply
\(\mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}\to0\); (27) tends to zero; and all
remaining terms tend to zero by construction or by
\(\text{lem:compact-moving-remainder-covariance}\).  This proves the asserted
compact limit.  Every supremum used above is over \(C\); hence the proof makes
no honesty or risk assertion outside the chosen compact set.
